description: Use when you sell an API over x402 and want it to pass Bazaar/CDP listing checks. Input: url (https x402 resource), method GET or POST. Output: JSON score 0-100, grade, per-check pass/warn/fail with fix hints (x402 v2 quote, accepts fields, USDC asset, payTo format and OFAC list, description quality, Bazaar schemas, header size, CORS, latency, openapi/llms.txt, ERC-8004) plus our measured uptime. Never pays. Example: ?url=https://1gateway.dev/v1/time/convert Price: $0.008 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.

method.description: HTTP method of the resource (POST sends an empty JSON body)

url.description: https URL of the x402 resource to grade (public host)

name: x402_lint
title: x402 seller linter: grade an x402 endpoint's 402 quote, Bazaar metadata and discovery docs
